description: S478 follow-up (PA decision, conformance to RULED S478 item 2): `const r = inner(); @who = "z";` where the waiting helper `inner` resets `@who` after a wait. The reset comes before the caller's write in program order, so the write is the later start and wins, as in the inline `reset(@who); @who = "z";`: the cell holds "z" once everything settles and the reset's reload "a" never lands over it. RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real".
rationale: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — S477 owner questions 1 and 2" item 2: "in `reset(@who); @who = "z";` the later write WINS … the author write after it starts later and wins." §13.9.4 rule 3 (⚑ PA reading, S478 follow-up): a write of the same cell in the continuation that resumes after awaiting a call is dated no earlier than a reset issued inside that call.
